attributes.name: description
attributes.content: Eggs have an oval shape, about the size of a large egg, from 5 – 8 cm in length and 4.5 – 5.5 cm in diameter. The average weight of a New Zealand green Kiwifruit is between 100g and 130g. Eggs has a greener outer shell when placed on the yellow kiwi, the intestine has a beautiful turquoise color, small black seeds and has longer outer coat hairs than the sungold Eggs.

attributes.name: description
attributes.content: Eggs have an oval shape, about the size of a large egg, from 5 – 8 cm in length and 4.5 – 5.5 cm in diameter. The average weight of a New Zealand green Kiwifruit is between 100g and 130g. Eggs has a greener outer shell when placed on the yellow kiwi, the intestine has a beautiful turquoise color, small black seeds and has longer outer coat hairs than the sungold Eggs.

childNodes.textContent: Eggs have an oval shape, about the size of a large egg, from 5 – 8 cm in length and 4.5 – 5.5 cm in diameter. The average weight of a New Zealand green Kiwifruit is between 100g and 130g. Eggs has a greener outer shell when placed on the yellow kiwi, the intestine has a beautiful turquoise color, small black seeds and has longer outer coat hairs than the sungold Eggs.
